# opencode-session-time

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/opencode-session-time)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-session-time)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)

Timestamps for your [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) V2 sessions: a current-turn
stopwatch in the prompt footer, a `Session Timings` block in the sidebar, and a
`/time` timeline popup.

> **v0.2.0–v0.2.1 contributed by [@ransagy](https://github.com/ransagy)** — last user
> input, last model thought and last model reply timings, relative ages, turn stopwatch,
> API backfill, durable persistence and throttled live refresh.

Small TUI plugin built on the official [`@opencode/plugin/tui`](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/build/plugins/cli/) API.

## What you get

| Where | What |
| --- | --- |
| Prompt footer (`prompt.footer.status`) | current-turn elapsed time, `⏱ MM:SS` (or `⏱ H:MM:SS`). Starts when the first assistant step begins after the last user input and freezes when the turn completes. If that step is outside the loaded message window, it falls back to the last user input time. |
| Sidebar (`sidebar.content`) | `Session Timings` block styled like the built-in `Context`/`MCP` blocks: session start, last user input, model thought phases (count ×N and total duration), and last model reply. Each row shows a timestamp and the relevant duration; rows refresh on data events. Historical values are backfilled from the API when they are outside the loaded window. Rows are sorted oldest to newest; rows without a timestamp stay at the bottom. |
| `/time` command (palette popup) | assistant turn timeline as a searchable popup, newest first: time, agent, model, duration, reply preview. **Enter** opens a per-turn details card (timing, tokens, cost, finish reason); **Esc** returns to the list, **Esc** again closes. |

The sidebar block updates live on data events, and relative ages refresh every second.
The prompt-footer timer is a turn stopwatch, not a wall clock; it shows `00:00` while
waiting for the first assistant step and `—` when there is no turn.

Per-session anchors are persisted in durable storage, so a TUI restart restores the
last input, thought, and reply immediately; the API backfill covers new sessions and
other devices.

Example:

```text
Session Timings
16:27:31 started · 1d ago
17:43:12 input · 3m ago
17:43:20 thought · 2.1s · 3m ago
17:44:02 reply · 8.4s · 2m ago
```

Same-day timestamps omit the date. Older timestamps include it (`23.10, 16:27:31`).

The prompt footer shows the current-turn stopwatch:

```text
⏱ 03:12
```

## Why the sidebar and not under each message?

The plugin API exposes slots for `app`, `home.footer*`, `prompt.footer*`,
`session.composer.top`, `sidebar.*` and `session.panel` — but there is **no slot for
the per-message footer**, and no settings option for it either. Inline per-message
timestamps would need an upstream `message.footer` slot. Until then, the sidebar block
is the closest native place.

## Install

TUI-only plugin. Install it from npm:

```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-session-time
```

`opencode plugin add` writes the plugin to your global CLI configuration and installs it.
Restart the TUI after installing. Alternatively, list the package in
`~/.config/opencode/cli.json`:

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": ["opencode-session-time"]
}
```

To pin a release tag or track the development branch directly from GitHub:

```bash
opencode plugin add github:LazyGatto/opencode-session-time#v0.2.1
```

Requirements: OpenCode V2; `@opentui/core`, `@opentui/solid`, `solid-js` are peer
dependencies provided by the host. This is a terminal-client plugin; web and desktop
clients do not load TUI plugins.

## Notes

- `/time` shows the timeline for the session you are currently in.
- The sidebar block uses `append`, so it appears after the built-in Context/MCP panels.
- Plugin edits hot-reload: the plugin is rebuilt on reconciliation, no TUI restart needed.

# Changelog

## 0.4.0 — 2026-11-11

- Redesigned sidebar: **Session** block (start time + request/step counters) and **Last answer**
  block (input, thought ×N + total, reply + duration, tool/MCP counts with per-tool breakdown).
- Two-tone rendering (values base, labels muted) via StyledText tags.
- Session counters computed once via full pagination, then refreshed from the message window.

## 0.3.4 — 2026-11-11

- Fix: aggregated thought duration was never shown — `dur(0, totalMs)` hit the
  `!start` guard and returned undefined. Added `durMs()` for precomputed durations.

## 0.3.3 — 2026-11-11

- `thought` row now aggregates all reasoning phases since the last user input:
  `thought ×N · <total duration>` (single phase stays `thought · <duration>`).

## 0.3.2 — 2026-11-11

- Sidebar `Session Timings` again shows plain timestamps/durations refreshed on data events.
  The ticking `x ago` ages are removed: the TUI repaints on activity, not every second
  while idle, so live ages froze and misled.

## 0.3.1 — 2026-11-11

- Clicking the prompt-footer timer opens the `/time` timeline popup (the popup itself is mouse-friendly: click, scroll).
- Reset the prompt-footer stopwatch to `00:00` when a new user message is waiting for its first
  assistant step, instead of continuing the previous turn's value. (contributed by [@ransagy](https://github.com/ransagy))
- Package metadata points back at the upstream repository. (contributed by [@ransagy](https://github.com/ransagy))

## 0.3.0 — 2026-11-08

- `/time` is now a palette-style popup (`dialog.select`): searchable timeline with the
  newest turns first, `ctrl+n`/`ctrl+p` navigation, `ctrl+a` to close. Replaces the
  session panel.
- Each timeline row previews the text reply. **Enter** opens a per-turn details card
  (timing, agent, model, tokens, cost, finish reason, reply preview); **Esc** returns
  to the timeline, **Esc** again closes it.
- `xlarge` + `centered` dialog presentation for both popups.

## 0.2.2 — 2026-11-08

- `/time` is now a toggle: a repeated command closes the panel
  (`context.ui.panel.current()` + `panel.close()`).

## 0.2.1 — 2026-10-27

- Sort `Session Timings` rows oldest to newest so the sidebar always shows the
  sequence of events; rows without a timestamp stay at the bottom.

## 0.2.0 — 2026-10-24

- Rename the sidebar block to `Session Timings`.
- Show session start, last user input, last model thought, and last model reply.
- Add relative ages (`just now`, `3m ago`, `2d ago`) that refresh every second.
- Add seconds to timestamps; same-day timestamps omit the date.
- Show thought and reply durations in the sidebar.
- Prompt footer now shows current-turn elapsed time (`⏱ MM:SS`), anchored to the first
  assistant step after the last user input and frozen when the turn completes. Falls
  back to the last user input time when the turn start is outside the loaded window.
- Backfill last user input, last text reply, and last thought from the API when they
  are outside the loaded message window; long tool-only runs no longer show `—`.
- Persist per-session timestamps in durable storage so the sidebar survives TUI
  restarts and crashes.
- Make live refresh event-driven with a 1s minimum interval, a 5s running fallback,
  and a final idle sync.
- `/time` panel now lists assistant turns only and includes turn durations.

## 0.1.1 — 2026-10-11

- Fix: explicit `@jsxImportSource @opentui/solid` (pragma + tsconfig) — the plugin loader
  compiles published packages with the React JSX runtime by default, which broke loading.
## 0.1.0 — 2026-10-11

- Wall clock in the prompt footer (`prompt.footer.status`).
- Sidebar block `Session`: `DD.MM, HH:mm started` / `DD.MM, HH:mm last answer`
  (`sidebar.content`, updates on data events).
- `/time` command: timeline panel with every turn's start/end time, agent and model.
